title: Persist a stable inquiry-confirmation result for HTTP composition
requirements: Extend only the existing confirm_inquiry command result so the accepted first execution stores and returns the documented stable owner response: command_id, inquiry as the complete updated InquiryDetail projection, and changed_visits containing exactly the confirmed visit id and post-command version. The response shape must be identical for the first execution and an accepted idempotent replay.

Build the InquiryDetail projection from the same PostgreSQL transaction after the confirmation mutation and before committing its receipt. Reuse or safely extract the established AdminInquiryReader projection semantics instead of creating a divergent private representation: contact snapshots, current contact, selected option, agreed terms, participation, cash notes/effective cash summary, notification summary and allowed_commands follow the existing owner-only detail contract.

Persist the complete stable confirmation response in operation_receipts.result_json. On a matching replay, deserialize and return that stored response without rereading current inquiry, visit, cash or notification state. A tombstoned or incomplete stored result remains RESULT_EXPIRED; a changed payload remains IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.

Preserve all accepted CMD-001 transaction guarantees: business_write_guard and locks precede mutation, expected versions and plan compatibility are checked, rejected commands leave business tables and receipt identity unchanged, exactly one participation/audit event is created for first acceptance, and no payment prerequisite, notification delivery, migration or external call is introduced.

Add isolated synthetic PostgreSQL coverage for first confirmation from NEW and NEGOTIATING, complete returned InquiryDetail and changed visit version, byte-for-byte-equivalent structured first/replay result after later persisted read-model facts change, receipt persistence, expired receipt, mismatch, and atomic rejection. Tests create random disposable databases and never read a local .env or use a configured source database.

Do not add HTTP routes, session or CSRF behavior, new command types, manual inquiry entry, payment commands, catalog changes, production runtime composition, frontend assets, bot adapters, migrations, secrets or external calls.
acceptance: A future authenticated HTTP adapter can return the complete documented confirmation result directly from the command result, including a replay that remains stable after later database changes.
Confirmation remains atomic, idempotent and independent from payment; detail projection does not weaken owner-only data boundaries.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted prerequisite for the documented stable owner confirmation response. It extends the existing transactional receipt and reuses the already authenticated inquiry projection without exposing a new route.
